content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to this forum. I've set up a project using [product_name] and it's working well. Now I would like to connect [product_name] to my wireless network. Is there a step-by-step guide for this process?

Hi, There isn't a specific step-by-step instruction available. It sounds like you have a router with wireless capability and want to connect mobile devices to [product_name], correct? If so, this process is quite straightforward. 1. Check the IP range used by your router's local network. 2. Assign an IP address to [product_name] that falls within this range. For example, if your wireless network uses 192.168.3.x, then [product_name] should have an IP like 192.168.3.y. 3. Connect [product_name] to a router port using a LAN cable. 4. Verify connectivity to [product_name]. 5. Enable the web server on [product_name], then open a mobile browser and enter its IP address. If everything is set up correctly, you should see the login page for the web server on [product_name]. Hope this information helps.
